preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string n is between 1 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: The length of each string s matches the given length n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '+-' for c in s) for s in [input().strip() for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of the characters '+' and '-'.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(s) for s in [input().strip() for _ in range(t)]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings s over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result == sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n + 1) if is_promising(s[i:j])) for result, (n, s) in zip(results, zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)])))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the number of non-empty promising substrings of the string s.
